introHtml: Hand wash only diner restaurant mugs preserve the look and feel of classic ceramic dinerware. Unlike dishwasher-safe alternatives, these mugs retain their glossy finish and bold imprint colors longer when washed by hand. Ideal for boutique cafes, retro-themed diners, or promotional giveaways where the mug's vintage aesthetic matters more than dishwasher convenience. Choose from traditional diner shapes and add your logo with full-color imprinting for a lasting impression.
